---
title: "Proteomics pre-processing: `r params$project_name`"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    df_print: kable
params:
  project_name: "MyProject"
  platform: "SomaScan"           # SomaScan, OLink, NULISA
  tissue: "CSF"                  # CSF, Plasma
  expr_file: ""
  traits_file: ""
  output_root: ""
  traits_id_col: ""              # "" = first column of the traits file
  expr_id_col: ""                # "" = platform default (SampleId / SampleID / SampleName)
  group_col: "Group"
  ctl_value: "CTL"
  blank_group: "remove"          # remove, case
  age_col: ""
  sex_col: ""
  sex_male_value: ""
  sex_female_value: ""
  drop_qc_fail: TRUE
  olink_npx: "raw"               # raw, PC
  use_fixed_lod: FALSE
  fixed_lod_file: ""
  lod_cutoff: NA                 # NA = platform default (0.75; NULISA 0.50)
  sn_crit: 0.3
  outlier_sd: 3
  outlier_distance_screen: FALSE
  outlier_robust_crit: 6
  plate_correct: FALSE
  n_boot: 1000
  n_cores: 1
  seed: 8675309
  winsor_k: 0.25
  winsor_sd: 5
  fixes_file: ""
  functions_file: ""
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6.5)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
p <- params
fn_file <- if (nzchar(p$functions_file)) p$functions_file else file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "..", "R", "preproc_functions.R")
source(fn_file, local = TRUE)
for (pk in c("SomaDataIO", "WGCNA", "limma", "diptest", "mclust", "boot"))
  if (!requireNamespace(pk, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package '", pk, "' is not installed.")
if (p$platform == "OLink") stopifnot(requireNamespace("arrow", quietly = TRUE))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(WGCNA::disableWGCNAThreads())
stopifnot(p$platform %in% c("SomaScan", "OLink", "NULISA"), p$tissue %in% c("CSF", "Plasma"))
lod_cutoff <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p$lod_cutoff))
if (length(lod_cutoff) != 1 || is.na(lod_cutoff)) lod_cutoff <- default_lod_cutoff(p$platform)
stopifnot("lod_cutoff must be between 0 and 1" = lod_cutoff > 0 && lod_cutoff <= 1)
npx_type <- if (p$platform == "OLink" && isTRUE(p$use_fixed_lod)) "PC" else p$olink_npx   # conflicts row 6
notes <- character(0)
```

## Run settings

```{r settings}
settings <- data.frame(Setting = names(p), Value = vapply(p, function(x) paste(format(x), collapse = ", "), ""))
settings <- settings[!settings$Setting %in% "functions_file", ]
settings$Value[settings$Setting == "lod_cutoff"] <- sprintf("%.2f", lod_cutoff)
if (p$platform == "OLink") settings$Value[settings$Setting == "olink_npx"] <- npx_type
settings
```

## Load data

```{r load}
traits.raw <- read_traits(p$traits_file, p$traits_id_col)
expr.raw <- read_expression_raw(p$expr_file, p$platform)
fx <- apply_dataset_fixes(p$fixes_file, expr.raw, traits.raw, p$platform, p$tissue)
expr.raw <- fx$expr.raw; traits.raw <- fx$traits.raw
ds <- build_dataset(expr.raw, p$platform, p$expr_id_col, npx_type, p$drop_qc_fail)
notes <- c(notes, ds$notes)
run_dir <- make_run_dir(p$output_root, p$project_name, p$platform, p$tissue,
                        panel = if (p$platform == "NULISA") ds$panel else NULL,
                        npx_type = if (p$platform == "OLink") npx_type else NULL)
qc_dir <- file.path(run_dir, "QC")
lab <- well_type_labels(p$platform)
wt  <- table(factor(ds$wells$well_type, levels = c("Sample", "Buffer", "Calibrator", "QC", "Other")))
wt  <- wt[wt > 0]
wt_names <- ifelse(names(wt) %in% names(lab), lab[names(wt)], names(wt))   # "Other" has no label; keep it as is
cat(sprintf("Expression matrix: %d features x %d wells (%s)\n", nrow(ds$exprMat0), ncol(ds$exprMat0),
            paste(wt_names, wt, sep = " = ", collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Traits: %d rows, ID column '%s'\n", nrow(traits.raw), attr(traits.raw, "id_col")))
cat("Output folder:", run_dir, "\n")
if (p$platform == "NULISA" && !all(is.na(ds$matrix_type)) && !toupper(p$tissue) %in% toupper(ds$matrix_type))
  warning("Tissue is set to ", p$tissue, " but the NULISA file says SampleMatrixType = ", paste(ds$matrix_type, collapse = ", "))
```

```{r fixes, results = "asis"}
if (fx$applied) {
  cat("### Dataset fixes applied\n\nThis script was run on the raw inputs before anything else:\n\n```r\n")
  cat(readLines(p$fixes_file), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n```\n")
}
```

## Match samples to traits

```{r match}
ds <- match_samples_to_traits(ds, traits.raw, p$group_col, p$ctl_value, p$blank_group, p$drop_qc_fail)
mr <- ds$match_report
show_ids <- function(x) if (length(x)) paste(head(x, 50), collapse = ", ") else "none"
cat("Samples in the expression file with no traits row (excluded):", length(mr$samples_not_in_traits), "\n ", show_ids(mr$samples_not_in_traits), "\n")
cat("Traits rows with no sample in the expression file:", length(mr$traits_not_in_data), "\n ", show_ids(mr$traits_not_in_data), "\n")
cat(sprintf("Samples with a blank '%s' (%s): %d\n  %s\n", p$group_col,
            if (p$blank_group == "case") "labelled Case" else "removed", length(mr$blank_group), show_ids(mr$blank_group)))
cat(sprintf("Samples failing platform sample QC (%s): %d\n  %s\n", if (isTRUE(p$drop_qc_fail)) "removed" else "kept",
            length(mr$qc_fail_samples), show_ids(mr$qc_fail_samples)))
study <- ds$wells$well_id[!is.na(ds$wells$pp_group)]
print(table(`Pre-processing group` = ds$wells$pp_group, useNA = "no"))
```

```{r mds.raw, fig.cap = "MDS of all study samples and control wells (at most 20 wells per control type)."}
qc_figure("MDS_raw_all_wells", function() plot_mds_wells(ds, paste(p$project_name, "- all wells")), qc_dir)
```

## Reference statistics, LOD and signal-to-noise

```{r lod}
ref <- compute_reference_stats(ds)
fixed_lod <- NULL
if (p$platform == "OLink" && isTRUE(p$use_fixed_lod)) fixed_lod <- load_olink_fixed_lod(expr.raw, p$fixed_lod_file, ds$featData)
below_all <- below_lod_mask(ds, ref, study, isTRUE(p$use_fixed_lod), fixed_lod)
cat(sprintf("Values below LOD in study samples: %.1f%%\n", 100 * mean(below_all)))
if (p$platform == "SomaScan") cat(sprintf("SomaLogic S:N groups: S0 = %d, S1 = %d, S2 = %d, S3 = %d\n",
                                          sum(ref$S0), sum(ref$S1), sum(ref$S2), sum(ref$S3)))
sn_all <- if (p$platform != "NULISA") signal_to_noise(ds, ref, study) else NULL
```

```{r lod.fig, fig.cap = "Fraction of study samples below LOD, per feature."}
qc_figure("fraction_below_LOD", function() {
  hist(rowMeans(below_all), breaks = 50, main = "Fraction of samples below LOD per feature",
       xlab = "Fraction below LOD", col = "grey70", border = "white")
  abline(v = lod_cutoff, col = "red", lty = 2)
}, qc_dir)
```

## Log2 abundance and sample outliers

```{r neat}
cleanDat.neat <- ds$exprMat0[, study, drop = FALSE]
if (ds$scale == "linear") { cleanDat.neat[cleanDat.neat <= 0] <- NA; cleanDat.neat <- log2(cleanDat.neat) }
numericMeta <- traits.raw[ds$wells$sample_id[match(study, ds$wells$well_id)], , drop = FALSE]
rownames(numericMeta) <- study
numericMeta$PreProcGroup <- ds$wells$pp_group[match(study, ds$wells$well_id)]
numericMeta$PlateID.expr <- ds$wells$plate[match(study, ds$wells$well_id)]
stopifnot(identical(rownames(numericMeta), colnames(cleanDat.neat)))
cat(sprintf("cleanDat.neat: %d features x %d samples; %d missing values\n", nrow(cleanDat.neat), ncol(cleanDat.neat), sum(is.na(cleanDat.neat))))
```

```{r outliers}
ol <- detect_outliers(cleanDat.neat, p$outlier_sd, isTRUE(p$outlier_distance_screen), p$outlier_robust_crit)
outliers <- ol$outliers
cat(sprintf("Outlier samples removed: %d\n", sum(outliers)))
if (any(outliers)) print(ol$table[ol$table$outlier, , drop = FALSE], row.names = FALSE)
post <- colnames(cleanDat.neat)[!outliers]
cleanDat.neat.PostSampOut <- cleanDat.neat[, post, drop = FALSE]
numericMeta.PostSampOut <- numericMeta[post, , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r outliers.fig, fig.cap = "Connectivity z-scores; samples below the dashed line are removed."}
qc_figure("outlier_connectivity", function() {
  plot(ol$table$z.connectivity, pch = 16, col = ifelse(ol$table$outlier, "red", "grey40"),
       ylim = range(c(ol$table$z.connectivity, -p$outlier_sd - 0.5)),
       ylab = "Connectivity z", xlab = "Sample", main = "Sample network connectivity")
  abline(h = -p$outlier_sd, lty = 2, col = "red")
}, qc_dir)
```

```{r mds.post, fig.cap = "MDS of study samples after outlier removal."}
qc_figure("MDS_post_outlier", function() plot_mds_wells(ds, paste(p$project_name, "- after outlier removal"), samples = post), qc_dir)
```

## Bimodal features

```{r bimodal}
bimodal_tbl <- detect_bimodal(cleanDat.neat.PostSampOut)
bimodal_features <- bimodal_tbl$Variable[bimodal_tbl$Bimodal]
cat(sprintf("Bimodal features removed: %d of %d\n", length(bimodal_features), nrow(bimodal_tbl)))
n_gmm_fail <- sum(is.na(bimodal_tbl$GMMComponents) & !is.na(bimodal_tbl$DipPValue))
if (n_gmm_fail) warning(n_gmm_fail, " features: the mixture-model fit failed, so they were not tested for bimodality.")
if (length(bimodal_features)) cat(" ", paste(head(bimodal_features, 100), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cleanDat.base <- cleanDat.neat.PostSampOut[!rownames(cleanDat.neat.PostSampOut) %in% bimodal_features, , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r plate, eval = isTRUE(params$plate_correct)}
cat("Plate regression (case/control protected)\n")
before_plate <- cleanDat.base
cleanDat.base <- regress_plate(cleanDat.base, numericMeta.PostSampOut$PlateID.expr, numericMeta.PostSampOut$PreProcGroup)
qc_figure("MDS_plate_regression", function() {
  op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2)); on.exit(par(op))
  pc <- as.integer(factor(numericMeta.PostSampOut$PlateID.expr))
  limma::plotMDS(before_plate[complete.cases(before_plate), ], col = pc, pch = 16, main = "Before plate regression")
  limma::plotMDS(cleanDat.base[complete.cases(cleanDat.base), ], col = pc, pch = 16, main = "After plate regression")
}, qc_dir, width = 11, height = 6)
```

## Covariates

```{r covariates}
ctl <- post[numericMeta.PostSampOut$PreProcGroup == "CTL"]
pc1 <- compute_pc1_scores(cleanDat.base, ctl)
numericMeta.PostSampOut$PC1score <- pc1$scores[post]
cat(sprintf("PC1 from %d control samples over %d features (%.1f%% of control variance)\n",
            length(ctl), pc1$n_features, 100 * pc1$var_explained))
covars <- data.frame(pc1score = pc1$scores[post], row.names = post)
mandatory <- character(0)
if (p$tissue == "CSF") {
  bep <- blood_eigenprotein(cleanDat.base, ds$featData, bimodal_features)
  r <- bep$report
  cat("Blood markers used:", show_ids(r$markers_used), "\n")
  cat("Blood markers removed earlier as bimodal:", show_ids(r$markers_removed_bimodal), "\n")
  cat("Blood markers not measured:", show_ids(r$markers_absent), "\n")
  if (is.null(bep$ep)) {
    warning("Fewer than 2 blood markers available; no blood eigenprotein, so no Blood regression.")
  } else {
    numericMeta.PostSampOut$bloodEigenprotein <- bep$ep[post]
    covars <- cbind(data.frame(bloodEP = bep$ep[post], row.names = post), covars)
    mandatory <- "bloodEP"
  }
}
if (nzchar(p$age_col)) covars$age <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(numericMeta.PostSampOut[[p$age_col]]))
if (nzchar(p$sex_col)) {
  sx <- recode_sex(numericMeta.PostSampOut[[p$sex_col]], p$sex_male_value, p$sex_female_value)
  covars$sex <- sx$sex
  numericMeta.PostSampOut$sex.numeric <- sx$sex
  cat(sx$note, "\n")
}
for (v in colnames(covars)) {
  if (stats::sd(covars[ctl, v], na.rm = TRUE) %in% c(0, NA)) {
    warning("Covariate '", v, "' does not vary among controls; dropped from the regression.")
    covars[[v]] <- NULL; mandatory <- setdiff(mandatory, v)
  }
}
cat("Covariates in the control-only regression:", paste(colnames(covars), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## Control-only bootstrap regression

```{r regression}
t0 <- Sys.time()
coefmat <- fit_ctl_bootstrap(cleanDat.base, covars, ctl, n_boot = p$n_boot, seed = p$seed, n_cores = p$n_cores)
cat(sprintf("Bootstrap regression: %d features, %d resamples, %.1f min\n", nrow(coefmat), p$n_boot,
            as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins"))))
cc <- center_covariates(covars)
notes <- c(notes, cc$notes)
regList <- c(list(cleanDat = cleanDat.base),
             generate_regressed(cleanDat.base, coefmat, cc$centered, mandatory))
cat("Matrices produced:", paste(names(regList), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r regression.fig, fig.height = 4}
for (nm in setdiff(names(regList), "cleanDat")) {
  cors <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(cleanDat.base)), function(i)
    suppressWarnings(cor(cleanDat.base[i, ], regList[[nm]][i, ], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")), numeric(1))
  qc_figure(paste0("correlation_", nm), function() hist(cors, breaks = 40, col = "steelblue", border = "white",
       main = nm, xlab = "Per-feature r, before vs after regression"), qc_dir, height = 4)
}
```

## Feature filters

```{r filters}
lod_res <- lod_filter(below_all[, post, drop = FALSE], lod_cutoff)
keep1 <- intersect(rownames(cleanDat.base), lod_res$keep)
cat(sprintf("1-pass (at most %.0f%% of samples below LOD): %d of %d features kept\n", 100 * lod_cutoff, length(keep1), nrow(cleanDat.base)))
sn_res <- NULL; keep2 <- NULL
if (p$platform != "NULISA") {
  sn_res <- sn_filter(sn_all[, post, drop = FALSE], lod_cutoff, p$sn_crit)
  keep2 <- intersect(keep1, sn_res$keep)
  cat(sprintf("2-pass (also S:N below %.2f in at most %.0f%% of samples): %d features kept\n", p$sn_crit, 100 * lod_cutoff, length(keep2)))
}
outList <- list()
for (nm in names(regList)) {
  m <- regList[[nm]]
  outList[[nm]] <- m
  outList[[paste0(nm, ".1pass.filtered")]] <- m[keep1, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!is.null(keep2)) outList[[paste0(nm, ".2pass.filtered")]] <- m[keep2, , drop = FALSE]
}
winsor <- lapply(outList, winsorize_matrix, k = p$winsor_k, n_sd = p$winsor_sd)
names(winsor) <- paste0(names(outList), ".", p$winsor_sd, "SDWinsor")
outList <- c(outList, winsor)
```

## Outputs

```{r write}
write_cleanDats(outList, run_dir, ds$featData)
utils::write.csv(numericMeta.PostSampOut, file.path(run_dir, "-traits", "numericMeta.PostSampOut.csv"))
invisible(file.copy(p$traits_file, file.path(run_dir, "-traits", paste0("input_", basename(p$traits_file))), overwrite = TRUE))   # copy, never move, the input
utils::write.csv(ol$table, file.path(run_dir, "-pre-proc", "sample_outliers.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(bimodal_tbl, file.path(run_dir, "-pre-proc", "bimodal_test.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(coefmat, file.path(run_dir, "-pre-proc", "regression_coefficients.csv"))
masterQC <- build_master_qc(ds, ref, bimodal_tbl, lod_res, sn_res, p$platform)
utils::write.csv(masterQC, file.path(run_dir, "-pre-proc", "masterQC.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
yaml::write_yaml(c(p[setdiff(names(p), "functions_file")], list(lod_cutoff_used = lod_cutoff, npx_type_used = npx_type)),
                 file.path(run_dir, "run_parameters.yaml"))
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(run_dir, "-pre-proc", "sessionInfo.txt"))
cat(sprintf("%d cleanDat files written to %s (human proteins only)\n", length(outList), file.path(run_dir, "-cleanDat")))
cat(sprintf("QC status: %s\n", paste(names(table(masterQC$`QC Status`)), table(masterQC$`QC Status`), sep = " = ", collapse = ", ")))
```

```{r notes, results = "asis"}
if (length(notes)) cat("## Notes\n\n", paste0("- ", notes, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```

rm(expr.raw)   # the raw file can be very large and is already on disk
save(list = ls(), file = file.path(run_dir, "-pre-proc", "final_workspace.RData"))
```
